newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Genesis seeks SEC, attorney general meeting.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Genesis seeks SEC, attorney general meeting.

text.p: Underwriter Pacific Genesis Group Inc said on Thursday it hoped to meet with Securities and Exchange Commission officials to "clear up" allegations surrounding several of its bond deals.

"We are in the process of requesting a meeting with the attorney general's office and the SEC to clear up any misconceptions coming from the Treasurer's office and look forward to meeting immediately to address these issues," said David Fitzgerald, chief executive of Pacific Genesis.

California state Treasurer Matt Fong has called on the Securities and Exchange Commission and the state attorney general to investigate nine municipal securities transactions underwritten by Pacific Genesis.
In these deals, Fong alleged illegal payments of bond proceeds were made, bond proceeds were used to retire private debts and bond professionals failed to identify the actual project beneficiaries.

"We would like a chance to review the allegations and immediately respond to them. We believe that these issues can be quickly addressed in a face-to-face discussion with the attorney general's office," Fitzgerald said.
